// Who We Are

Built from real field work.
Managed with discipline.

JBA Property Solutions LLC supports field inspection and property operations for insurance, mortgage servicing, asset management, and property preservation workflows. Our work is practical: find the correct property, document the condition, follow the work-order instructions, and submit clean reports with the photos needed for review.

Our operation is built around the issues that matter in the field: pre-contact and scheduling, door-knock documentation, occupancy verification, rural access, lockbox or access notes, entry-method details, safety concerns, and fast follow-up handling when a client asks for clarification.

Technology helps us organize routes, track open work, review photos, monitor zones, and identify repeat QC issues. The final standard is still simple: accurate field information, clear documentation, and no guessing.

“The goal is not to make the site look bigger than the operation. The goal is to show clients that JBA understands field execution, documentation, QC, and real route problems.”

— JBA Operations Standard

// Learn More

Field service standards clients care about.

The content below is based on common mortgage field service and insurance inspection categories: property condition, occupancy status, insurance policy data, insurance loss progress, property preservation, and vendor training/QC.

Property Inspections

Designed to help clients understand occupancy status, visible property condition, damage indicators, and whether follow-up work may be needed.

  • Exterior and interior documentation
  • Occupancy and condition indicators
  • Photos tied to work-order requirements

Insurance Policy Inspections

Supports underwriting and risk review with field data from residential or commercial properties, depending on the client request.

  • Property characteristics
  • Hazard or access concerns
  • Carrier-specific photo requirements

Insurance Loss / Progress Checks

Documents repair progress after a claim so clients can verify work status and make better decisions around the next step.

  • Repair progress photos
  • Scope-related notes
  • Clear completion observations

Property Preservation Support

Field observations help protect vacant or distressed assets by flagging security, safety, maintenance, and deterioration concerns.

  • Vacancy and security notes
  • Yard, exterior, and hazard observations
  • Access and lockbox clarification

Work Order Compliance

Every order must match the address, instructions, client requirements, access condition, and photo matrix. This reduces preventable follow-ups.

  • Door-knock and contact notes
  • GPS/time-aware route discipline
  • Entry method and access documentation

Training & QC Culture

Strong vendor operations depend on training, clear expectations, and fast correction of repeat issues before they become client escalations.

  • Inspector accountability
  • Photo completeness review
  • Follow-up reason tracking
Important: JBA should avoid publishing unverifiable numbers like exact national inspector count, exact QC percentage, or “every ZIP” unless those figures are supported by current internal data. The site now uses stronger, safer language: active zones, multi-state operations, QC before submission, and photo-first documentation.

// Quality Control

QC before submission.
Facts before assumptions.

The strongest reports are simple: correct address, clear access history, required photos, accurate occupancy notes, and documented exceptions.

01

Pre-Contact & Scheduling

Appointment windows, policyholder contact notes, access restrictions, dog/gate concerns, and timing issues are tracked when required.

02

Door Knock / Access Protocol

Inspectors document attempts, access path, entry method when applicable, and reasons why access was not possible or not safe.

03

Photo Evidence Collection

Required angles, address verification, roof/structure photos when required, lockbox/key evidence, and exception photos are reviewed.

04

Occupancy & Condition Notes

Vacancy indicators, utilities when observable, hazards, yard/driveway/porch/deck/fence condition, and damage details are written plainly.

05

Follow-Up Accountability

Repeat issues are tracked by inspector, reason, city/state, zone, and work-order type so corrections can be made quickly.

Privacy & Field Documentation Notice

Information submitted through this website is used to respond to client inquiries and inspector applications. Field photos and property information should only be used for authorized work-order purposes and handled according to client requirements. JBA Property Solutions is a field services operation and does not act as an insurance carrier, public adjuster, mortgage servicer, or legal advisor. Any coverage, turnaround, or volume commitment must be confirmed in writing based on active ZIP coverage, route capacity, access conditions, and client instructions.
